question: What is the five-natured teaching in Bhairavas abode?
premises: Thence, in fullness, in the abode of all-enduring Bhairava.
This five-natured teaching-meaning is the Śāmbhavas.
It treats the abiding of śakti and atom-soul.
inference: The Śāmbhava teaching stands five-natured in Bhairavas abode on śakti-aṇu-abiding.
plain_english: Thence, in fullness, in the abode of all-enduring Bhairava: this five-natured teaching-meaning is the Śāmbhavas — on the abiding of śakti and atom-soul.
